A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper right edge of her figure to the lower left edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 38% of the way along its length and runs to the upper left edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 59% of the way along its length and runs to the lower right edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper right): it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper left): it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower right): it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, orchid formations in DEEP VIOLET and EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower left): it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
